findings.description: The env schema renames SUPABASE_KEY to SUPABASE_API_KEY, but neither .env.example nor the CI workflow is updated to match — the build will fail everywhere the old name is still provided.
findings.suggestedFix: Rename the variable in .env.example and .github/workflows/ci.yml in the same PR, or revert the schema rename.

findings.description: The client factory change has no accompanying test although existing integration tests cover the previous behavior.
findings.suggestedFix: Extend tests/supabase-client.test.ts with a case for the new option.

summary: The env-var rename is unsynchronized across `.env.example` and CI, which matches the rubric's criterion-6 failure anchor. Sync the rename in this PR or revert it; the remaining changes are sound.
